style.styleTitle: Nkuku Set of 12 Oko Mini Star Christmas Baubles
style.toneOfVoice: A classic addition to festive decorating, these mini baubles are interpreted in a new star shape, offering a playful twist on a classic form. Finished in a heritage-inspired matte tone, they bring soft texture along with subtle warmth to trees, wreaths, and table settings. Their delicate size makes them ideal for layering into displays, adding a handmade touch that feels both simple and special. Each Sari tie is one of a kind, so the piece you receive will vary slightly from the images shown, due to its individual character. Dimensions(mm): Height: 30 Width: 1500 Depth: 30.
